outcomes.name: The skills and learning approach has been refined based on pilot learnings
The skills and learning approach is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Skills & Behaviour to identify what needs to change in the skills and learning approach before scaling.
Refine the skills and learning approach to Skills & Behaviour based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined skills and learning approach covering Skills & Behaviour ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined skills and learning approach for Skills & Behaviour is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the skills and learning approach for Skills & Behaviour remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the skills and learning approach affected People Experience & Culture.
Adapt the skills and learning approach relating to People Experience & Culture for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the skills and learning approach covering People Experience & Culture to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor People Experience & Culture among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the skills and learning approach for People Experience & Culture.
